variants.subject: Worm castings ingredient for {{company_name}}?
variants.body:
Hi there,
I came across {{company_name}} and your soil product line — looks like you're doing great work in the organic space.
I run Sweet Leaf Soil in Wisconsin. We produce bulk, finely-screened worm castings that soil blenders are using as a premium ingredient in their mixes. OMRI-listed, consistent quality, available in supersacks or bulk loads.
A few things that matter for blenders:
- Consistent particle size (finely screened)
- Low moisture content for accurate blending ratios
- Reliable supply — we produce year-round
Would it make sense to send you a sample to evaluate as an ingredient? No commitment — just want you to see the quality firsthand.
Colton Heil
Sweet Leaf Soil

Hi there,

Following up — I know ingredient sourcing decisions don't happen overnight, but wanted to make sure this landed.

We're currently supplying castings to blenders in the Midwest and can scale to meet production schedules. 

Happy to send specs (nutrient analysis, moisture content) along with a sample.

Worth a quick look?

Colton
sweetleafsoil.com

Hi there,

Last email from me on this — just one thing I wanted to share.

Blenders adding worm castings at 5-10% of their organic mixes are using it as a premium differentiator on the shelf. 

It's a margin play — castings let you charge more per bag while improving the actual product performance.

If ingredient sourcing is ever on your radar, I'd love to send a sample and spec sheet. Open offer.

Best,
Colton
sweetleafsoil.com
